name: Outreach Reply Listen
description: Hourly companion to the Outreach Lead-Gen Pipeline: the listener agent polls the outreach mailbox via mcp__outreach__check_replies (read-only IMAP - nothing is marked read, deduped by Message-ID), classifies each reply's intent, and records it with mcp__outreach__record_reply_intent - which ends follow-ups for that prospect and permanently opts out unsubscribe/bounce inside the connector. Interested/question replies trigger one digest email to the operator. Requires the outreach MCP connector with OUTREACH_IMAP_* env and the 'Outreach Reply Listener' agent. Replace REPLACE_WITH_LISTENER_AGENT_ID before POSTing; then activate and PUT /api/workflows/{id}/schedule (e.g. cron '*/30 * * * *').

data.label: Scheduled trigger (cron on the workflow, e.g. every 30 min)
Listener: check replies, classify, record intents, escalate
